summary: All /music slash-command replies are now sent as silent notifications — no push notification or ping on Discord.
details: Every /music command reply (play, skip, top, queue, pause, resume, stop, volume — including the error/empty states and the now-playing control panel) now passes silent=True to the interaction followup.
Previously only the auto-advance "Now playing" channel notification was silent; the command replies themselves still triggered a push notification on Discord.
The messages still appear in the channel as before — silent only suppresses the notification/ping, not the message.
limitations: Nora's conversational replies (the agent path after a tag, e.g. the reply to a play_music tool call) are unchanged — they are replies to a person, not system notifications.
